shortDefinition: Melusina's universal connector — how pearls request capabilities from other pearls with your approval.

children.text: Grapple replaces ad-hoc permissions with capability requests. When a pearl needs something — AI, payment, email, another pearl's data — it sends a request through Grapple. You see a picker with your options and choose which specific pearl to connect.
No blanket permissions: each connection is between two specific pearls.
Human choice: you pick which pearl to connect every time.
Revocable: disconnect any connection with one click.
Persistent: capabilities survive pearl restarts via AppPersistent.Save().

seo.title: Grapple — Universal Connector
seo.description: Definition of Grapple, Melusina's capability request system that connects pearls with user approval.
